title: What is C#
description: Understand C# and its role in .NET development.

data.text: **C#** (pronounced 'C Sharp') is a modern, object-oriented programming language developed by Microsoft. It's the primary language for .NET development and is used for building web, desktop, mobile, and cloud applications.

items: **Modern language**: Continuously updated with latest features
**Type safety**: Static typing catches errors at compile time
**Great tooling**: Visual Studio, VS Code, Rider

data.text: C# runs on the .NET platform, which provides a runtime (CLR), base class libraries, and tools. .NET is cross-platform, running on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

data.title: Open Source
data.text: Both C# and .NET are open source. The .NET runtime and compiler are developed on GitHub.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: C# is a modern, object-oriented language
data.takeaway: C# is a powerful language for modern development.
